Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Craft

Desks and writing supplies.

Craft Options. When you issue the Craft order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Craft: Book Replica. The hireling copies a nonmagical book into a blank book in 7 days.

Craft: Spell Scroll. The hireling scribes a Spell Scroll of one Cleric or Wizard spell of level 3 or lower. The facility has the Calligrapher's Supplies and the hireling meets every prerequisite; the Crafting Equipment rules of the Player's Handbook give the time and the cost, which you pay.

Craft: Paperwork. The hireling makes up to fifty copies of a broadsheet, a pamphlet, or another loose-leaf paper product in 7 days, for 1 GP per copy, and can distribute them to one or more places within 50 miles of your Bastion at no extra cost.
